title: Yonto link sign-in services
description: contracts/link-logins.json: each service a host runs a link sign-in for, as data its one sign-in engine reads. A field is named by a dot path into a JSON answer, the empty path being the answer itself. A template may name {clientId} (the host's own identifier for the source, never the plugin's installId), {product} (Yonto), and in the poll {id} and {code} from the start's answer: percent-encoded in a URL, and written as they are in a header or a body's value, which a form body then form-encodes. An OAuth client_id is the literal the service registered, never {clientId}, which differs per install. A credential header's value names {credential}. See docs/design/2026-09-24-a-code-the-viewer-links.md.

accountDomain.description: Where the service's account lives: every host its sign-in and discovery ask is this or below it, and no plugin's allowedHosts may admit it or anything below it.

visit.description: The page the viewer is sent to, shown as text; every URL or QR the service shows must be on its host or below it.

headers.description: Sent on every request of the sign-in and the discovery.

id.description: The answer's handle on this sign-in, which the poll names as {id}.

expiresIn.description: How long the code lasts, in seconds: a number the answer carries at `field` where it carries one, `seconds` otherwise. Either is held to 10 seconds to an hour.

interval.description: How long to wait between polls: a number the answer carries at `field` where it carries one, `seconds` otherwise.

qr.description: What the QR carries: a template, or a field of the answer. One not on the visit site is replaced by the visit address.

credential.description: Where a linked answer carries the account credential.

outcomes.description: Read in order, the first that matches deciding; an answer none matches is a failed poll.

present.description: A field the answer must carry, not null.

equals.description: What `field` holds, compared as JSON: 1 is not "1", and true is not 1.

is.description: `slower` is pending, and asks every later poll to wait `bySeconds` longer (RFC 8628's slow_down).

accountHeader.description: The header the account credential goes in, on the discovery request alone.

servers.description: Where the list of the account's resources sits.

where.description: Which resources are servers: a field holding a comma-separated list, or an array, that includes a word.

owned.description: Whether the account owns the server, which the host binds no credential for. A service that declares none owns nothing.

credential.description: The server's own credential: never handed to the plugin, bound to the server's hosts.

serverHeader.description: The header a server's credential goes in, on each hop to a host it is bound to.

identity.description: What a server answers without a credential about which server it is, asked before a typed address is first sent one.

headers.description: Sent as written: the service's own headers, and so its placeholders, never go to a server the viewer typed.

body.description: What the request sends, its Content-Type set by the engine: `form` as application/x-www-form-urlencoded, `json` as a JSON object of strings. Each value is a template.

credentialHeader.description: A header's name, and its value with the credential written {credential}, exactly once: `Bearer {credential}`, or `{credential}` alone.
